text:
Before the meal, the plate held a toasted ham/cheese sandwich (two triangles, so one sandwich cut in half) and 5 sushi roll pieces (salmon and cucumber maki). In the second photo the plate is nearly empty, with only small crumbs and stains, so I'm treating everything as eaten.

Sandwich: two slices of toast with ham and cheese comes to roughly 280 kcal and about 130 g.

Sushi: 5 maki pieces at about 30-35 g each is roughly 165 g. At about 1.4 kcal/g that is roughly 230 kcal.

Total: about 510 kcal and 295 g.
